name: manual_af0d30
claim: A compound shell command that begins with a bare cat > file and no heredoc blocks forever waiting on stdin, so everything after it never runs. A backgrounded gh pr create hung this way for minutes and the PR body file was never written. Write PR bodies with the file-writing tool, run gh with a hard timeout and stdin from /dev/null, and check that the body file exists before creating the PR.
conditions: gh pr create hang stdin cat body-file timeout

decisions.notes: 2026-11-17: the first PR-creation command hung on a stray cat; a retry showed the body files did not exist; after writing them with the Write tool and using timeout 90 with stdin from /dev/null both PRs were created.

rationale: 2026-11-17: the first PR-creation command hung on a stray cat; a retry showed the body files did not exist; after writing them with the Write tool and using timeout 90 with stdin from /dev/null both PRs were created.
